scope: All 32 exact relative-word token uses, the 9 E01 rounds, and related explicit comparison/height-reasoning contexts. Not an exhaustive child-comprehension review of all 1110 rounds.

The written character itself is the task evidence, not a substitute for a pictured size relation.
Physical action and parent observation remain ungraded; no fabricated pictorial answer.
An explicitly defined mathematical comparison model, not a word-meaning illustration.
Unknown relative heights are the inference target. Painting absolute heights would reveal an unearned answer.

method: Inspected all eight originals, the 680×1360 contact sheet, desktop rendered cards and 375px responsive cards. Adult visual QA does not establish child comprehension.
